content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IIT Delhi Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: 1st class B.Tech in Bio-Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology. One year of research experience working on nanoscale bioelectronics in a research lab.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Research Associate Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Research Associate.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a 1st class B.Tech in Bio-Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology, along with one year of research experience in nanoscale bioelectronics.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, New Delhi - 110016.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
